hero.name: Gautam
hero.role: I turn UI/UX designs into responsive, cross-browser React interfaces.

about.heading: Frontend craft with production habits.
about.lede: A detail-oriented frontend developer building responsive interfaces, reusable components, and polished project experiences.
story: I work across the front-end stack, from translating UI/UX designs into clean HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React components to debugging, maintenance, and performance work.

My projects cover e-commerce flows, real-time SaaS dashboards, and immersive 3D portfolios. I like component systems that are easy to reuse, interfaces that work across browsers, and code that stays understandable when the product grows.

highlights.text: Design-to-code conversion for responsive, cross-browser web pages
Reusable React components with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and state management
Performance-minded UI work: code splitting, lazy loading, and optimized API usage
Mobile-first layouts, UI debugging, maintenance, and live project collaboration
